review:
I really wanted to like Dreadzone. It has a gritty, post-apocalyptic vibe concept that could’ve been a hit—but right out of the gate, the pacing felt slow and uninspired. The intro tasks dragged, and it took far too long to get to anything engaging.

Once I started exploring more, a few things stood out in a frustrating way:

Cons:

Enemies are tanky and respawn way too quickly—sometimes before I could even finish looting. They weren’t challenging, just annoying.

Weapon selection early on is extremely limited: just a knife and a pistol. And with no HUD ammo counter, I had to constantly open the inventory to check.

The AI followed me for unexpectedly long distances, which felt unbalanced.

Human combat encounters felt stale and repetitive.

Even after adjusting DLSS, resolution, and other settings, the graphics still left a lot to be desired.

I only played on keyboard and mouse, so I can’t speak to controller support.

Pros:

The concept has potential. There’s a solid foundation here if the devs continue to refine and build on it.

I'm willing to leave my purchase as a donation to the developers in the hope they can turn this into something special over time.

Final thoughts:
Dreadzone feels like it needed more time in development. I’ll check back on it periodically, but as it stands now, I’m having a hard time finding the motivation to keep playing. I truly hope the team puts everything they’ve got into polishing it up—because there’s a chance this could grow into a game worth the time and money.

review:
Ascend was one of the only games I actually remember playing when I was younger on the PC. So, In my hype to experience it again at a later age I was like "Hey, I've been meaning to up my FPS Game and this stuff is both familiar, and nostalgic somehow!"

My blind, gullible behind stood no chance against it! I was blindsided by filthy con artists, charlatans, deviants and vagabonds!

But in all seriousness, dropped alot to buy this game only to find 90% of the servers were bots and I was no where near as good as I thought I was. Gameplay loop is spectacular admittedely, but nowhere near the previous games and lacks basically everything besides the actual FEEL of the game. No vehicles, less gamemodes, worse soundtrack (Same one in every match but... Dull, only picking up when you get to hold the objective for a few seconds because your teams farming skill kills, which tbf, is way more fun). 

Wanted this game to be good, very good. Unfourtunately, everything down to the DLC is a scam. 

DLC is a year pass for skins, by the way. You are guaranteed a new skin each day for each DLC you own.. Unless you don't play a select number of games to *earn* the skin you paid for. And if you don't play on that day, you lose a day you can't get back. So if you aren't playing for 120 days of the 364 it gives you, that's 120 skins you can't unlock in your funny new video game. Why? Screw you, that's why. 

Refused to refund me for anything, too. Actually harpooned me in. Anti cheat is also Whack (Denuvo), so don't worry about filthy pirates getting in! They've got to make sure you've spent your money, after all.

Typically I'm optimistic but with this company, this is a passing trend for them, which sucks, because they clearly have talent. Too bad all they wish to churn out is slop.

I will actually list some of the positives though!

Fun gameplay loop
Classes are kinda funny, bit pointless sometimes, but funny.
The artstyle looks nice if it doesn't remind me of reskinned unreal assets. The guns, however, do look pretty nice and functional for the setting.
Maps are pretty well put together for the movement system, though the most popular one is a big bowl, so, do with that as you will.
Game punishes you for using full auto spam weapons by making them basically horrible unless it's for finishing someone off. The weapons themselves, besides these, are stupid fun to play with.
Finally: The destroy the base concept is pretty good, but underutilised. Bases need to be bigger and a little more complex instead of being slip in, slip out, the moment you get to the enemy spawn. Especially since you can just repeat it until it blows up with no penalty, as it doesn't really have any way of stopping you from doing so.

review:
Since purchasing this, almost no new content has been added. Despite this being an "early access" game, it already feels as though it's bordering upon being abandoned. The maps are frankly piss-poor, low effort garbage, with no detail or interest and nothing to facilitate good/interesting gameplay. Each map basically feels like a reskin of the same shitty map that looks as though it was made in under an hour using a game engine from 2005.

There is a ton of AI generated content in this game, and it really shows. Everything about it feels creatively dead/bankrupt. I believe most of the skins available in the game are in some way AI generated, and are equally as uninspired. (And.. for the most part, only available via a ridiculously overpriced year-long subscription to a "Daily Cosmetics Pass" that costs more than double the price of the actual game.)

It honestly feels as though the intention of Prophecy Games was to boil Tribes down to it's absolute core barebones mechanics and absolutely nothing else. They have decided to forgo any actual content or any of the charm/flare present in  of any previous titles in the series. And not only that, but they've chosen to do so with the least amount of cost/effort humanly possible.

Also, the servers are dead. Overall GLOBAL player count averages around 30-35 people, occasionally spiking to 50, maybe 60. And if you live in the wrong timezone? Sorry, you're looking between 5-7 players globally. And if that isn't enough to put you off, Prophecy have done absolutely ZERO to combat people cheating/hacking, so when you do get into a game that has a slightly less awful population (which will universally be populated by people who entirely ignore the gamemode you're playing and just deathmatch until the timer runs out) you'll probably just get ran down by someone aimbotting and/or speed hacking.

Absolute waste of time, do not waste your money.
Tribes is dead.
